d:
Rojana ke khane ke sath thali men parosiye imyuniti barhane vala aanvla, hari mirch aur adrak se bana ye chatapta Amla Thecha Chutney Achar. bina dhup, bina jhanjhat kuchh hi minton men taiyar ho jata hai. masalon ki khushbu aur aanvle ka test donon ka svadisht bailens . dekhiye Amla Thecha Pickle, Amla Chutney aur Amla Achar ki aasan resipi.
Ingredients for Amla Chutney Pickle
Aanvla - Amla - 200g
Hari mirch - Green Chilli - 50g
Adrak - Ginger - 50g
Saunph - Fennel seeds - 1 tbsp
Pili sarson - Yellow Mustard - 1 tbsp
Methi dana - Fenugreek Seeds - 1 tsp
